parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Length $AD=2+2r$ — B1. Must be seen alone or as part of a list and not part of a product.
Arc length $=r\pi/3$ — B1. May be implied by $r\times\pi/3\times2$; must be seen alone or part of a list and not part of a product.
$EF=2+2r\sin(\pi/6)$ or $2+2r\cos(\pi/3)$, i.e. $2+r$ — B1. Must be seen alone or as part of a list and not part of a product.
$4+3r+2r\pi/3=6$, leading to $r=0.393$ — B1. AWRT; condone $2/(3+2\pi/3)$. NB: using $EF=2.4$ gives 0.391.
Total: 4.
